verdict.rationale: A paper, fax, or mail fallback with published addresses, numbers, and forms is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. The pack contains only two probes, which got HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in; nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched. There is therefore no evidence either way about an offline filing rail, and confidence is low because the content could not be read rather than being shown to lack this.
